speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fables. There are woodcuts. There are no riddles. Thou asked for a book with none.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I asked in April. If the first page is a riddle, it goes back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I looked for a riddle and did not find one.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Woodcuts. And no riddle on the first page. Then it is the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The ballad is thine, Judith. I will sing it once. I will sing it badly.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Once is what I need of a tune. Sing.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I have the tune. Sing the rest worse, if you must. I am collecting the words.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I have the tune and the words. I had it before dinner, and dinner is not yet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am done singing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The woodcuts are in the book. The sheet has no title I kept.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This one is for thee. It has been in Plutarch.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Who is Plutarch?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A Greek. Master Field will tell thee he is very dear.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The foot of it is chipped. I will keep the letter.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You wrote who, and it should be whom.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Master Aspinall has the right of it. Whom.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: And the queen? Did she hide?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She steps into the shadow of the trees. Thou hadst it right before I told thee.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Three weeks, then?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Till the eighteenth.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Hm.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The ballad is mine. You sang it badly, and I have it anyway.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The H stays beside the nail until I take them both in.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The book comes in with me. Whom, and the shadow of the trees.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take the book in. The bench can have the nail and the letter a minute longer.
